workarounds.symptom: Poki Setup macOS dmg is arm64-only: installer fails on Intel Macs with EBADARCH (-86)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: build universal Poki Setup installers for Intel Macs. Target files: .github/workflows/desktop-mac.yml, desktop/mac/scripts/bundle.sh, desktop/mac/scripts/check-universal.sh. Poki Setup's published DMG contains only arm64 executables, so Intel Macs cannot start the app or its helpers. Build universal installers on every desktop workflow run and by default in the local packaging script, using the existing Rust and Swift builds for both architectures. (Ref: https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki/pull/365)

workarounds.symptom: Relay reconnect selects CLOSING WebSocket: phone shows online but MCP returns 503 (repro + tested fix)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(relay): skip closing sockets after phone reconnect. Target files: deploy/cf-relay/src/index.js, deploy/cf-relay/worker.js, deploy/cf-relay/test/relay.test.js. After a phone reconnects, an authenticated old WebSocket can remain CLOSING ahead of its OPEN replacement. MCP requests then return HTTP 503 even though the new connection is ready. (Ref: https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki/pull/316)
